visual.description: Full-width dark section with large left-aligned heading text, a subtitle below, and a right-aligned 'New' announcement badge in the upper right — no image, just text on black background.
Full-width product UI mockup panel showing a 3-column app interface (sidebar navigation, main issue panel, detail panel) embedded below the hero text.
Full-width continuation of the product mockup showing an agent activity feed on the left and a kanban/issue board on the right, split roughly 40/60.
Three equal-width cards each with a 3D isometric icon, a bold title, and a short description below, on a black background.
Left half has a large bold heading, right half has a paragraph of body text — equal-width two-column split with no imagery.
Left side shows a chat/comment thread UI panel, right side shows a task board grid of 2×3 issue cards — approximately 40/60 split.
Left half has a large bold heading, right half has body text and a version badge link — equal two-column split, with a horizontal timeline/roadmap component spanning full width below.
Left panel shows an initiatives list sidebar, right panel shows a Gantt-style horizontal timeline with labeled milestones — approximately 30/70 split.
Left half has a large bold two-line heading, right half has body text and a version badge — identical structure to the product-direction section above it.
Full-width code diff panel showing a side-by-side before/after file comparison in a dark terminal-style UI with file path header.
Left half large bold heading, right half body text and version badge — same repeating two-column layout pattern used throughout the page.
Left panel shows a Weekly Pulse card with project status entries, right panel shows a scatter plot chart (Cycle time by agent) — roughly 40/60 split.
Left panel continues the pulse/status list with on-track indicators, right panel continues the scatter plot chart with agent name labels on x-axis.
Full-width black section with a single large left-aligned 'Changelog' heading, no other content visible.
